headline: Apple’s foldable ‘iPhone Duo’ will reportedly start at $2,000
summary: Apple's long-rumored folding phone is reportedly named 'iPhone Duo'. It's expected to launch with a starting price of $2,000. This news comes just before Apple's next iPhone event.

headline: Sony isn’t phasing out discs quite as quickly as we thought
summary: Sony is still committed to ending video game disc production by January 2028. However, the company isn't shutting down production as rapidly as initially reported. A previous detail about a discmaking plant's repurposing was incorrect.

headline: Drama swirls around OpenAI’s legendary mathematical milestone
summary: OpenAI claims to have solved the Navier-Stokes problem, a mathematical challenge unsolved for 90 years. This breakthrough relates to the complex flow of liquids and gases. The announcement has sparked significant attention and discussion.

headline: Rivian spinout Also apologizes for delays in shipping futuristic e-bikes
summary: Rivian's micromobility spinoff, Also, has apologized for delays with its futuristic TM-B e-bike. The software-controlled e-bike features a unique pedal-by-wire system and USB-C charging. Customers are expressing disappointment over the unexpected wait.

headline: IGN Australia and Chupa Chups to Host a Retro Gaming ‘Fun House’ Activation at Westfield Parramatta This October
summary: IGN Australia and Chupa Chups are partnering to host a 'Retro Gaming Fun House'. This interactive event will be held at Westfield Parramatta. Gaming enthusiasts can experience retro fun this October.

headline: Hands on: Tianji: Shadow of the Ancients
summary: This article provides an in-depth hands-on preview of 'Tianji: Shadow of the Ancients'. Get first impressions on gameplay mechanics and visuals. Discover what to expect from this new title.

headline: Netflix Orders Lonesome Dove TV Series From East of Eden Showrunners
summary: Netflix is adapting Larry McMurtry’s classic Western novel 'Lonesome Dove' into a new TV series. Zoe Kazan and Jeb Stuart, from 'East of Eden', are helming the project. The iconic story is set to return to screens.

headline: AMC Theaters Is Broadcasting the 2026 Rocket League World Championship Finals at Select Cinemas Across the US
summary: AMC Theaters will broadcast the 2026 Rocket League World Championship Finals. Fans can watch the esports event in select cinemas across the United States. Experience the competition on the big screen.

headline: Paul Adams: British-Israeli relations at lowest ebb in decades
summary: British-Israeli relations have reached their lowest point in decades. This follows London's trade ban on Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank. The move signals a significant shift in diplomatic ties.

headline: Drug gangs exploited and raped us as teens, then police failed us, women tell BBC
summary: Four women have told the BBC they were exploited and raped by drug gangs as teenagers. They accuse police of failing to take their claims seriously. The shocking report details systemic failures in protection.

headline: 'Constantly on my mind' - 9/11 agony endures for bereaved, 25 years on
summary: Twenty-five years after 9/11, the agony for bereaved families remains profound. The alleged mastermind of the attacks is still awaiting trial. This protracted wait continues to affect those seeking closure.

headline: Very hot drinks may damage the food pipe and increase cancer risk
summary: Experts warn that consuming steaming hot liquids can damage the cell lining of the esophagus. This damage may elevate the risk of developing certain cancers. It's advised to let hot beverages cool before drinking.
